about:
# RXP Dialogue Badges

Mark Dialogue UI quest offers that match your active RestedXP guide.

For **World of Warcraft: Forever** (interface 16001).

- Small guide badges on relevant quest offers.
- Follows the active guide step.
- Does not accept quests or replace dialogue controls.

## Requirements

RXPGuides, DialogueUI

## Controls

Enable with RestedXP Guides and Dialogue UI.

## Installation

Install through CurseForge or extract the ZIP into your Forever Interface/AddOns folder. Keep the packaged folder name `RXPDialogueBadges` unchanged; this also preserves existing saved settings. Enable the listed dependencies.

## Publishing

Push a stable annotated version tag matching the TOC, such as `v1.0.1`, to publish. GitHub Actions validates the source and packages a GitHub release; the connected CurseForge native packager handles the CurseForge Release file through its push webhook. No CurseForge publishing token belongs in this repository or its Actions secrets.

## Feedback

[Report an issue](https://github.com/bhuddleston42/RXPDialogueBadges/issues) with the addon version, expected behavior and Lua error if available.

## Testing

Release packaging and Lua syntax are checked automatically. Included regression tests use simulated game APIs. Real gameplay and combinations of third-party addons can expose additional issues; please report them.
